rosterStatus: 36 indexed entries now represented using the supplied community hero indexes: 33 carry secondary-source faction/troop/rarity/season metadata; three Season 4 entries remain explicitly marked Verify. This is a community reference roster, not an official or current-client verified roster. Exact skills, costs, gear and formations remain subject to in-game confirmation.
verificationPolicy: All hero classifications and profile notes are secondary-source community data, not official publisher data. Current-client confirmation is pending. Skill summaries are paraphrased and coefficients/costs are omitted where sources are inconsistent or not independently confirmed. Do not treat null as none. Fourth-skill exclusive talents are not Exclusive Equipment.
developmentGuidance: Choose heroes for role, faction synergy, troop type and formation position rather than power score alone.
Concentrate scarce fragments, EXP, skill books and equipment on a small group actually deployed in your main formation.
Check whether a skill is global, march-only, deployment-only or faction-count dependent before investing.
Prioritize a hero's distinctive passive only when its scope and deployment requirement match the job you need.
Treat profile skill names and formation suggestions as community-reference snapshots; verify live text, target, star breakpoints and skill levels before spending.
Do not equate a fourth-skill exclusive talent with the separate Exclusive Equipment system.
